title: Generative AI for Climate-Resilient Urban Emergency Planning
summary: A generative-AI evaluation framework that trains and compares five tabular synthesizer families (GaussianCopula, CTGAN, TVAE, ForestDiffusion, TabSyn) on a real-world emergency-events dataset from metropolitan Porto, assessing fidelity, utility, privacy, and energy cost. SDV's GaussianCopulaSynthesizer and CTGANSynthesizer are run to generate synthetic emergency scenarios, its SingleTableMetadata schema is built for each dataset, its evaluate_quality quality-report metric scores all model outputs, and its Condition API drives conditional scenario sampling.
